verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs show rule-based approval routing to stakeholders based on vendor/category/amount and role-based notification workflows, plus policy-grounded recommended approve/reject actions, which supports building structured approval chains. However, there is no evidence of explicit multi-step manager→budget-owner→finance sequencing, delegation of approval authority, or escalation logic when an approver doesn't act. missing for 10: explicit delegation feature, escalation/timeout rules, and multi-tier approval chain configuration details.
